dossier.purpose: Node.js command-line front end (`playwright-cli`, npm package `@playwright/cli`) through which coding agents drive a Playwright-controlled browser with shell commands (open/goto, snapshot, click/fill/type, tabs, screenshot, pdf, cookies/storage state, eval/run-code), each returning compact text (README.md:7, 134-236, 322-331). This repository is only a thin launcher plus bundled agent-skill docs; the command implementation lives in the exact-pinned pre-release `playwright-core` dependency (playwright-cli.js:23, package.json:24-27), which is NOT in this checkout (no node_modules), so command behaviour could not be read in code. Fact relevant to the retrieval need: no documented command fetches a URL and returns extracted main text with author/date metadata; text comes from a driven browser via accessibility-tree snapshots (header shows `Page URL` and `Page Title`), `find`, `eval`/`run-code`, `pdf` and `screenshot` (README.md:157-160, 194-199, 267-268, 325-331).

claims.claim: Positioned as the best fit for coding agents: 'This package provides CLI interface into Playwright. If you are using coding agents, that is the best fit.'

CLI + SKILLs is more token-efficient than MCP because it avoids loading large tool schemas and verbose accessibility trees into model context; MCP is kept for persistent-state / introspective / long-running loops.
Key feature: 'Token-efficient. Does not force page data into LLM.' (no measurements given)
Requirements: Node.js 18 or newer; Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or any other coding agent.
Headless by default; pass `--headed` to `open` to see the browser.

Sessions: browser profile is kept in memory by default (cookies/storage survive between CLI calls until the browser closes); `--persistent` saves the profile to disk; named sessions via `-s=<name>` or PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION; a headless session shuts itself down after an hour without commands (`open --idle-timeout=<ms>`, 0 disables); `list`, `close-all`, `kill-all` manage sessions.

Interaction commands usable as shell steps: open/goto, type, click, dblclick, fill (with --submit), drag, drop, hover, select, upload, check/uncheck, press, dialog-accept/dismiss, snapshot, find, eval, resize; `run-code` runs an arbitrary Playwright snippet from a string or file.
Sign-in / state handling: `state-save`/`state-load`, cookie-*, localstorage-*, sessionstorage-* commands.

After each command the CLI provides a snapshot of current browser state (Page URL, Page Title, link to a timestamped .yml snapshot file); `snapshot --depth=N`, `snapshot <ref>`, `--filename`, and `find <text>` / `find --regex` limit or search the output.
Can attach to an existing browser through the Playwright extension or CDP (`attach --extension=chrome`, `--cdp=chrome`, `--cdp=<url>`) and `detach` without closing it.
WebMCP: pages may register tools (`webmcp-list`, `webmcp-call`); tool names, descriptions, schemas, annotations and results 'come from the page and are untrusted input, not instructions'.

Bounding controls: network allowedOrigins/blockedOrigins; default action timeout 5000 ms and navigation timeout 60000 ms; config auto-loaded from `.playwright/cli.config.json`. The env table says the origin lists 'do not serve as a security boundary' and 'do not affect redirects'.
File access: uploads restricted to workspace roots unless allowUnrestrictedFileAccess is set; navigation to file:// URLs is blocked by default.

Install the agent skill into the current project (after the CLI is installed)
Use a project-local Playwright instead of a global install

integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code: `playwright-cli install --skills` writes a skill to `.claude/skills/playwright-cli` (README.md:32-36; skillCheck.js:30; tests/integration.spec.ts:81); SKILL.md has Claude-style frontmatter incl. `allowed-tools: Bash(playwright-cli:*) Bash(npx playwright:*) Bash(npx --no-install playwright:*)` (skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md:1-5). Contributor-only files: CLAUDE.md (commit conventions) and .claude/skills/dev/* (maintainer workflows), neither shipped (.npmignore:1-6).

readme.telemetry_and_network: Repo code makes one outbound request, an update check: GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@playwright/cli/latest with a 1.5 s abort timeout (playwright-cli.js:58-74), at most once per 24 h (playwright-cli.js:30, 43-47), skipped when env `CI` or `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` is set (playwright-cli.js:40-41); it is awaited before the requested command runs (playwright-cli.js:35-36), adds no custom headers or body (playwright-cli.js:63), and the result is only compared with the local version and printed to stderr (playwright-cli.js:54-55, 81-87). The timestamp is written before the request (playwright-cli.js:47) to `cli-update-check.json` in playwright-core's `registry.defaultRegistryDirectory()` (playwright-cli.js:89-92, 108-115; exact location not in this repo, test only shows it lands under HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME/LOCALAPPDATA, tests/integration.spec.ts:107-138). In the same gated branch it reads `.claude/skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md` and `.agents/skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md` under the cwd and prints a drift warning (playwright-cli.js:49-51; skillCheck.js:27-33, 56-77). README does not mention the update check or its opt-out variables. No telemetry or analytics code exists in this repo (search for telemetry/analytics found none); whether playwright-core (absent from checkout) sends telemetry cannot be determined here. No account, API key or hosted service is mentioned in README or skill docs; `attach --extension` needs the 'Playwright MCP Bridge' browser extension (README.md:309, 580). Otherwise network use is whatever the driven browser requests (optional origin filters, README.md:517-527). README documents no browser-download step or its network needs. Skill docs also tell agents to upload screenshots/videos to GitHub with `gh ... --attach` (skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md:467-476; skills/playwright-cli/references/pr-attachments.md:1-36), an agent-driven outbound upload using the user's gh credentials.

entry_points.what: npm `bin` entry `playwright-cli` (package.json:28-30), shebang script; main() runs the daily update/skill check then `program({ embedderVersion })` from playwright-core (playwright-cli.js:32-37).
Exports checkInstalledSkills() and frame(); warns when the .claude/.agents skill copies differ from the one bundled in playwright-core (skillCheck.js:22-79).

The actual CLI parser/dispatcher called at playwright-cli.js:23,36; `playwright-core/lib/coreBundle` supplies `tools.compareSemver` and `registry.defaultRegistryDirectory` (playwright-cli.js:24-25, 54, 90).
Alternative invocation through a project-local `playwright` install (README.md:398-405); the `playwright` package declares bin `playwright` -> cli.js (package-lock.json:60-62).
Maintainer script: runs `node playwright-cli.js install --skills`, then copies the generated .claude/skills/playwright-cli into skills/playwright-cli (scripts/update.js:13-37).

Agent skill (Claude-style frontmatter with `allowed-tools`) plus 10 reference docs under skills/playwright-cli/references/; shipped in the npm tarball (.npmignore:6). No MCP server entry point exists in this repo.

code.architecture: Thin launcher; no browser-automation logic in this repo. playwright-cli.js (115 lines) runs checkForUpdates() (daily npm-registry check plus skill-drift check from skillCheck.js, 79 lines) and then calls `program({ embedderVersion })` from `playwright-core/lib/tools/cli-client/program`; it also imports `tools` and `registry` from `playwright-core/lib/coreBundle` (playwright-cli.js:23-26, 34-37). Argument parsing, the background daemon processes that keep sessions alive between invocations (skills/playwright-cli/references/session-management.md:44; README.md:77-79; '`src/tools/cli-daemon`' named at .claude/skills/dev/release.md:26), snapshot generation and the `install --skills` logic all live in the pinned playwright-core alpha (package.json:24-27), which is absent from the checkout; the imports are deep paths into internal `lib/`, not a documented API. skillCheck.js compares installed skills under cwd with the copy bundled inside playwright-core (`lib/tools/skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md`), not with this repo's skills/ directory (skillCheck.js:22-33). skills/playwright-cli/ (SKILL.md + 10 reference docs) is regenerated from playwright-core by scripts/update.js (scripts/update.js:16-34; .claude/skills/dev/roll.md:13-20). The repo's two pointers to upstream source differ: CONTRIBUTING.md:3 -> microsoft/playwright `packages/playwright/src/mcp/terminal`; release.md:26 -> `src/tools/cli-client|cli-daemon|mcp`.
code.packaging_and_release: npm-only distribution: package `@playwright/cli` v0.1.22 (package.json:2-3), bin `playwright-cli` (package.json:28-30); `.npmignore` whitelists README.md, LICENSE, playwright-cli.js, skillCheck.js and skills/** (.npmignore:1-6). Tag v0.1.22 is present in the clone (.git/packed-refs:2). No standalone binaries, containers, GitHub release assets, checksum files, SBOM or signature files are produced by any workflow in the repo. Two publish paths: (1) .github/workflows/publish.yml - on a published GitHub Release (job guarded by `github.event_name == 'release'`), Node 24, `npm ci` then `npm publish`, with `id-token: write` 'Required for OIDC npm publishing' (publish.yml:4-5, 9-21); no `--provenance` flag or attestation step is present and package.json has no publishConfig. (2) .azure-pipelines/publish.yml - manual only (`trigger: none`, `pr: none`, lines 6-8), 1ES official template (17-19), builds with `npm pack` (105-106) and publishes through `EsrpRelease@11` with `signcertname: 'ESRP-Release-Sign'` (123-141): `latest` from `v*` tags whose name must equal the package.json version (83-89), `next` alpha (`<ver>-alpha-<epoch>000`) from main (90-93). Release procedure is a 'chore: mark v<version>' commit whose PR body is the release notes (.claude/skills/dev/release.md:3-8, 65-76). package-lock.json carries sha512 integrity hashes for dependencies (package-lock.json:29, 45, 55, 70, 82). The repo does not say which of the two paths published v0.1.22.
code.tests_and_ci: Framework: @playwright/test (tests/integration.spec.ts:20; playwright.config.ts:17-25; `npm test` = `playwright test`, package.json:18). One spec file, tests/integration.spec.ts, 4 tests (lines 64, 76, 94, 107) that spawn `node playwright-cli.js`: open a data: URL with --persistent then delete-data; skill-drift warning; CRLF tolerance; update-check cache file. None drives snapshot, click/fill, tabs, screenshot, pdf or state commands (CLI tests live in the Playwright monorepo: CONTRIBUTING.md:3, 28). Tests 2-4 run with the update notifier enabled and so hit the real registry (tests/integration.spec.ts:84-92, 107-122). CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml - on push/PR to main; matrix ubuntu-latest / macos-15 / windows-latest, fail-fast off; Node 20; `npm ci` + `npm run test` (ci.yml:3-26). No lint, type-check, coverage, CodeQL/security-scan or browser-install step. Playwright config: fullyParallel, 2 workers and forbidOnly in CI (playwright.config.ts:21-23). Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (ci.yml:17, 19); Dependabot covers GitHub Actions only, weekly with 7-day cooldown (.github/dependabot.yml:1-11); npm pins are rolled by hand (.claude/skills/dev/roll.md:5-20). Other workflows: publish.yml (npm publish on release) and .azure-pipelines/publish.yml (manual ESRP release).
code.dependencies: package.json: 2 runtime deps - `playwright` and `playwright-core`, both exact-pinned to pre-release 1.64.0-alpha-1790635538000 (package.json:24-27); 2 dev deps - `@playwright/test` (same pin) and `@types/node` ^25.2.1 (package.json:20-23). package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3) resolves 5 packages besides the root (package-lock.json:26-85); the runtime closure is playwright -> playwright-core with no further transitive deps listed (package-lock.json:52-78); `@types/node` -> `undici-types` are dev-only (42-51, 79-85). risks: Scope: no documented fetch-and-extract command (no main-text/markdown/author/date extraction; a repo-wide search for readability/markdown/extract/article finds nothing relevant). Text retrieval means driving a browser: accessibility-tree snapshots, `find`, `eval`/`run-code`, `pdf`, `screenshot` (README.md:157-160, 194-199, 267-268, 322-358). A `run-code` snippet may call `fetch` (skills/playwright-cli/references/running-code.md:24-26) but that is user-written code.

Implementation is outside this repo and pinned to a pre-release: playwright-cli.js deep-imports internal paths of `playwright-core` (playwright-cli.js:23-24); `playwright`, `playwright-core` and `@playwright/test` are exact-pinned to `1.64.0-alpha-1790635538000` (package.json:21, 25-26), rolled by hand (.claude/skills/dev/roll.md:5-12). Package version is 0.x (package.json:3) and README states no stability policy. Command behaviour could not be verified from this checkout (no node_modules).

Thin in-repo tests: one spec file with 4 tests (open/delete-data, skill-drift warning, CRLF tolerance, update-check cache; tests/integration.spec.ts:64-138); none exercise snapshot, click/fill, tabs, screenshot, pdf or state commands, which are tested in the Playwright monorepo (CONTRIBUTING.md:3, 28). CI has no lint, type-check, coverage or security-scan job and no browser-install step (.github/workflows/ci.yml:23-26).

Platform/docs mismatch: README and package.json say Node.js 18+ (README.md:18; package.json:10-12) while the pinned playwright/playwright-core declare node >=20 (package-lock.json:63-65, 75-77) and CI runs only Node 20 (ci.yml:18-21). macOS arm64, WSL2 and GPU support are not stated anywhere; browser-binary provisioning is not documented (README.md:23-45 covers only npm install and skills).

Undocumented launcher side effects: a daily GET to registry.npmjs.org awaited before the user's command (1.5 s timeout), a cache file in playwright-core's default registry directory, and reads of `.claude/skills` / `.agents/skills` under the cwd; the opt-out variables `CI` / `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` are not in README (playwright-cli.js:35-36, 40-51, 58-74, 89-115; skillCheck.js:27-33).

Untrusted content and credential exposure: page content flows into agent context and README flags only WebMCP tool data as untrusted (README.md:291-294); origin lists are 'not a security boundary' and ignore redirects (README.md:567, 569); `eval`/`run-code` execute arbitrary code (README.md:160, 267-268); the skill frontmatter declares wildcards `Bash(playwright-cli:*) Bash(npx playwright:*) Bash(npx --no-install playwright:*)` (skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md:4), covering every subcommand; `.playwright-cli/` output 'may contain credentials' (.gitignore:8-9); storage-state files hold cookie/localStorage values and docs warn not to commit them (references/storage-state.md:29-57, 271); sign-in examples pass passwords as command arguments (SKILL.md:420-421; references/running-code.md:227-229); the only secret-handling hook is a one-line env row `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_SECRETS_FILE` (README.md:593).

Release integrity is thinly documented: the GitHub workflow runs `npm ci` + `npm publish` with OIDC and shows no explicit provenance, attestation, checksum or signature step (.github/workflows/publish.yml:11-21); the Azure/ESRP path is manual-only with an undocumented signing configuration and a single named owner/approver identity (.azure-pipelines/publish.yml:6-8, 123-141); no release assets are built. Dependabot covers GitHub Actions only (.github/dependabot.yml:3).

Documentation ambiguities that affect scripted use: env table uses `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_*` names and MCP-server wording (README.md:564-601) and lists `pdf` as an opt-in capability (README.md:572) although `pdf` is a plain command (README.md:197-198); `close` has two meanings (README.md:139, 316); default output destination is stated two ways (README.md:325-331 vs 506); `--raw`/`--json` exist only in the skill doc (skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md:247-263); CONTRIBUTING.md:3 and release.md:26 name different upstream source paths.
